help.description: A quick guide to the StockIA flow and answers to the most common questions.
help.guide-title: How StockIA works, step by step
help.guide-intro: Follow these steps in order the first time. Each one ends with a link to the section.

inventory.title: Register your supplies
inventory.body: In Inventory, create each supply with its unit, current quantity, minimum stock, shelf life and unit price. The expiration date is calculated from the shelf life.
inventory.tip: Quantities accept up to 32 decimals, e.g. 0.125 kg.

recipes.title: Create the recipes of your dishes
recipes.body: In Recipes, add the supplies each dish uses and the quantity per portion. The dish price is the sum of the cost of those ingredients.
recipes.tip: If the unit price of a supply changes, the dish price updates by itself.

sell.title: Sell a dish
sell.body: Press "Sell one" on a recipe. StockIA checks the stock first and discounts the supplies only if every ingredient is available and not expired.
sell.tip: If a supply is missing or expired, the sale is not registered and a message explains why.

sales.title: Review the sales history
sales.body: Sales history lists every confirmed sale, newest first. A sale can be voided, but the supplies used are not returned to stock.
sales.tip: The history is the data the demand forecast learns from.

alerts.title: Attend the alerts
alerts.body: Alerts warn you about low stock, critical stock and supplies about to expire, by WhatsApp and email.
alerts.tip: A critical alert must reach both channels before it can be marked as attended.

forecast.title: Check the demand forecast
forecast.body: Demand forecast projects the dishes you will sell in the next days, so you can buy on time.
forecast.tip: Generate a new forecast after registering several sales.

recommendations.title: Apply the recommendations
recommendations.body: Recommendations suggest purchases and menu adjustments based on the forecast and the alerts.
recommendations.tip: Only the Administrator sees and applies recommendations.

team.title: Invite your team
team.body: In Roles & permissions, invite members as Administrators or Employees and change their role when needed.
team.tip: The team always keeps at least one Administrator.

settings.title: Adjust your account
settings.body: In Settings › Account settings, edit your profile and restaurant data and change your password.
settings.tip: To change the password you must type the current one first.

roles-rows.operation: Dashboard, inventory, recipes, sales, forecast, alerts and help

no-stock.q: Why was my sale not registered?
no-stock.a: Because a supply of the recipe is missing or does not reach the required quantity. StockIA never sells without stock: the sale is not saved in the history and the stock does not change.

expired.q: Can I sell a dish whose supply is expired?
expired.a: No. Expired lots are never used. If the only stock of a supply is expired, the sale is rejected and the message tells you which supply expired.

freshest.q: What happens if I have two lots of the same supply?
freshest.a: Register each lot as a supply with the same name and unit. When you sell, StockIA skips the expired lots and uses the freshest one first; the inventory marks it as "Used first in sales".

dish-price.q: How is the price of a dish calculated?
dish-price.a: It is the sum of each ingredient's quantity per portion multiplied by its unit price in the inventory. The sale is registered with that price.

decimals.q: How many decimals can a quantity have?
decimals.a: Up to 32 decimals, both in the inventory and in the recipes. You can use a dot or a comma as decimal separator.

void.q: If I void a sale, does the stock come back?
void.a: No. A voided sale stays in the history as voided, and the supplies already used are not returned.

critical-alert.q: Why can't I mark a critical alert as attended?
critical-alert.a: Critical alerts must be delivered by WhatsApp and by email first. Retry the missing channel and then mark it as attended.

roles.q: What can an Employee not see?
roles.a: Employees cannot open Roles & permissions, Recommendations, the subscription type or Upgrade plan. Everything else is available.

password.q: How do I change my password?
password.a: Go to Settings › Account settings › Change password, type your current password and then the new one twice.

language.q: How do I switch the language?
language.a: Use the EN / ES buttons in the header. StockIA always opens in English.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms explain how DataBit provides StockIA to restaurants. By creating an account you accept them.

service.title: The service
service.body: StockIA helps restaurants manage supply lots, recipes, sales, alerts and demand forecasts. Forecasts and recommendations are estimates and do not replace the judgment of the restaurant.

accounts.title: Accounts and roles
accounts.body: The owner of the restaurant is its first Administrator and is responsible for the team members invited. Keep your password private; after 5 wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes.

data.title: Data and privacy
data.body: The data of each restaurant is only visible to its team. We use it to run the service and to train the demand model with aggregated, anonymous sales; we do not sell it.

payments.title: Plans and payments
payments.body: The Esencial plan is free. Paid plans renew every 30 days. In this academic version payments with Stripe and PayPal are simulated and no real charges are made.

predictions.title: Forecasts and automated decisions
predictions.body: Demand forecasts come from a machine learning model trained with the restaurant's own sales, the Peruvian calendar and the weather. They are estimates with a stated confidence level: StockIA shows them as suggestions and never buys, discards or changes stock without a person's action, except the deduction of a sale the team registers.

ethics.title: Professional and ethical responsibility
ethics.body: DataBit develops StockIA following the Software Engineering Code of Ethics and Professional Practice (ACM/IEEE) and the Code of Ethics of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP): we act in the public interest and in the interest of our clients, we are honest about the limits of the product (for example, which features are simulated in this version), we protect the confidentiality of the data entrusted to us and we report and fix the defects we find.

availability.title: Availability and changes
availability.body: We work to keep the service available, but it may be interrupted for maintenance or failures. If these terms change, we will publish the new version on this page with its date before it applies.
